```{r Libraries, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
Sys.setlocale("LC_ALL", "en_US.UTF-8")

#!/usr/bin/env Rscript
library(ggplot2)
library(ggdist)
library(boot)
library(readr)
library(readxl)
library(tidyr)
library(dplyr)
library(tibble)
library(stringr)
library(purrr)
library(gridExtra)
library(lme4)
library(lmerTest)
library(glmmTMB)
library(MASS)
library(brms)
library(HDInterval) 
library(mirt)
library(cowplot)
library(grid)
library(ggdist)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(colorspace)
```


```{r}
m <- read_rds("../models/cor_scaled/indicos_gaze_duration.rds")
mode <- "InDiCo"

pe <- brms::fixef(m, probs = c(.025, .975)) 
popeff <- pe["prev_len", "Estimate"]

ran <- ranef(m)
ran_subj <- ran[["subj_id"]]
# ran_subj
indi <- as.data.frame(ran_subj[, , 1:14]) %>%
  dplyr::select(`Estimate.c1:prev_len`, `Q2.5.c1:prev_len`, `Q97.5.c1:prev_len`,
                `Estimate.c2:prev_len`, `Q2.5.c2:prev_len`, `Q97.5.c2:prev_len`) %>%
  mutate(., across(dplyr::contains("prev_len"), ~ . + popeff)) %>%
  rename(spmu_len_c1 = `Estimate.c1:prev_len`,
                splo_len_c1 = `Q2.5.c1:prev_len`,
                spup_len_c1 = `Q97.5.c1:prev_len`,
                spmu_len_c2 = `Estimate.c2:prev_len`,
                splo_len_c2 = `Q2.5.c2:prev_len`,
                spup_len_c2 = `Q97.5.c2:prev_len`) %>%
  rownames_to_column("subj_id") %>%
  arrange(spmu_len_c1) %>%
  mutate(subject = factor(subj_id, levels = subj_id),
         mode = mode) %>%
  dplyr::select(subject, spmu_len_c1, splo_len_c1, spup_len_c1,
                          spmu_len_c2, splo_len_c2, spup_len_c2) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c("spmu_len_c1", "splo_len_c1", "spup_len_c1", "spmu_len_c2", "splo_len_c2", "spup_len_c2"),
    names_to   = c(".value", "contrast"),
    names_pattern = "(sp..)_len_(c[12])"
  ) %>%
  mutate(contrast = factor(contrast, levels = c("c1", "c2"), labels = c("Session 1", "Session 2")))
  dplyr::select(subject, contrast, spmu, splo, spup)

View(indi)

sum_indi <- indi %>%
  dplyr::group_by(contrast) %>%
  dplyr::summarize(mean = mean(spmu),
                   lq   = mean(splo),
                   hq   = mean(spup),
                   .groups = "drop")
sum_indi
```

```{r}
ggplot(indi, aes(x = spmu, xmin = splo, xmax = spup, y = subject, color = contrast)) +
  geom_errorbarh(height = 0.3, size = 0.5) +
  geom_point(size = 1) +
  geom_vline(data = sum_indi, aes(xintercept = mean, color = contrast), linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_vline(data = sum_indi, aes(xintercept = lq,   color = contrast), linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_vline(data = sum_indi, aes(xintercept = hq,   color = contrast), linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.3) +
  facet_grid(. ~ contrast) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Session 1" = "black", "Session 2" = "black")) +
  xlab("(a) Participant-level Word Length Spillover effect in InDiCo") +
  # xlab("") +
  ylab("Participant ID") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    legend.position      = "none",
    panel.grid.major.x   = element_line(linewidth = 0.2, colour = "grey85"),
    panel.grid.major.y   = element_line(linewidth = 0.2, colour = "grey90"),
    panel.grid.minor     = element_blank(),
    panel.background     = element_blank(),
    panel.border         = element_rect(colour = "grey70", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.4),
    strip.text           = element_text(face = "bold"),
    strip.background     = element_blank(),
    panel.spacing.x      = unit(2, "pt"),
    axis.text.y          = element_text(size = 9),   # smaller y-axis tick labels
    axis.title.x = element_text(margin = margin(t = 10))  
  )

ggsave(filename = paste0("../visualization/paper/reliability/by-subject_indico_len.pdf"), width = 5, height = 8, dpi = 300
)
```

```{r}
pe <- brms::fixef(m, probs = c(.025, .975)) 
popeff <- pe["prev_surp", "Estimate"]

indi_surp <- as.data.frame(ran_subj[, , 1:14]) %>%

sum_surp
```
